description: Dependency bump PRs into dev (never main: merging main deploys). One click to merge; CI on the PR is the gate. Monthly, exact pins: a PR installs exactly the versions it names (2026-11-09: open >= ranges let uv lock rq 3.0.0 into a PR titled rq 2.12).

packageRules.description: Monthly: every non-major Python package in one PR.
Monthly: GitHub Actions in one PR (tests/unit/scripts/test_workflows.py keeps the Node 24 / pinned-runner rules).
Monthly: base and service images in one PR.
ruff in pyproject and in .pre-commit-config.yaml move together.
uv: the Dockerfile image and the pre-commit hook move together.

Downloaders: site extractors break and get fixed between releases, so daily, no wait, nightlies allowed (yt-dlp is pinned to nightlies on purpose, pyproject.toml). The POT provider's server image (docker-compose.yml, pinned `latest@sha256:...`: Renovate proposes each new digest) moves with its yt-dlp plugin.
yt-dlp nightlies: uv's plain --upgrade-package stays on the stable release (2026-11-09: PR said 2026.11.4.232659.dev0, the lock got 2026.10.26), so the >= bound in pyproject.toml has to move.
Postgres/Redis majors change the on-disk format of prod data (dump/restore): never as a bump PR.

SQLAlchemy stays below 2.1 until opentelemetry-instrumentation-sqlalchemy supports it (0.66b2: sqlalchemy<2.1.0): logfire.instrument_sqlalchemy() raises at startup on 2.1 (PR #70, 2026-11-09). The <2.1 in pyproject.toml alone does not stop Renovate: it rewrites the range.
requires-python stays a range (>=3.15): the pep621 manager reads it as the `python` dependency, and the global pin would make it ==3.15.x while the image tag python:3.15-slim rolls to the next patch.
Python stays on 3.15 (prod image, mypy python_version, .python-version) until moved on purpose.
